output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds an arbitrary amount of tokens to the target balance without any check, causing a constant supply increase.

The transferFrom function allows the owner to transfer tokens from one account to another. However, it does not check if the spender has enough tokens to transfer, allowing a spender to transfer any amount of tokens.

The approve function allows the owner to approve a spender to spend tokens on behalf of the owner. However, it does not check if the spender is a valid address, allowing a spender to be set to a zero address, causing a loss of funds.
